instruction:
You are a senior mechanical engineer specializing in vibration isolation.

## Problem

Calculate vibration transmissibility for a damped single-degree isolation system.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Forcing frequency | {{ forcing_frequency_hz }} | Hz |
| Natural frequency | {{ natural_frequency_hz }} | Hz |
| Damping ratio | {{ damping_ratio }} | - |

{% if archetype_description is defined %}
### Isolation Context

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A vibration transmissibility calculation tool is available at `/workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate the following:

1. Frequency ratio
2. Transmissibility
3. Isolation efficiency in percent

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Use frequency ratio = forcing frequency / natural frequency.
- Use the damped force transmissibility equation provided by the tool.
- Use isolation efficiency = (1 - transmissibility) x 100.

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "frequency_ratio": <numeric_value>,
  "transmissibility": <numeric_value>,
  "isolation_efficiency_pct": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "vibration-transmissibility"
description = "Damped vibration transmissibility calculation"
long_description = "Calculates force transmissibility for a damped single-degree vibration isolation system from forcing frequency, natural frequency, and damping ratio. The template reports frequency ratio, transmissibility, and isolation efficiency."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "vibration"
standards = ["ISO 20816"]
tags = ["mechanical", "vibration", "isolation", "transmissibility", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.forcing_frequency_hz]
type = "float"
unit = "Hz"
description = "Excitation or forcing frequency"
min = 0.1
max = 200.0

[params.natural_frequency_hz]
type = "float"
unit = "Hz"
description = "Isolator natural frequency"
min = 0.1
max = 100.0

[params.damping_ratio]
type = "float"
unit = "-"
description = "Viscous damping ratio"
min = 0.0
max = 1.0

[outputs.frequency_ratio]
description = "Ratio of forcing frequency to natural frequency"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.transmissibility]
description = "Damped force transmissibility"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.isolation_efficiency_pct]
description = "Isolation efficiency"
tolerance = 0.03

[archetypes.pump_isolator]
description = "Pump or fan vibration isolator"
forcing_frequency_hz = {min = 20.0, max = 80.0}
natural_frequency_hz = {min = 2.0, max = 15.0}
damping_ratio = {min = 0.02, max = 0.25}
site_contexts = ["plant-room-pump", "fan-isolator"]

[archetypes.precision_equipment]
description = "Precision equipment vibration isolation"
forcing_frequency_hz = {min = 5.0, max = 60.0}
natural_frequency_hz = {min = 1.0, max = 10.0}
damping_ratio = {min = 0.02, max = 0.35}
site_contexts = ["laboratory-equipment", "precision-machine-base"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All parameters given for a pump isolator"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["pump_isolator"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All parameters given across isolation systems"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["pump_isolator", "precision_equipment"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "All parameters given for precision equipment isolation"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["precision_equipment"]
